_doc: System gate (systems.rs). This shipped map is an example; put your own in $BORG_SYSTEMS (default: systems.json next to the collectives config, ~/.config/borg/systems.json), which replaces it. 'systems': a system and the name parts that mean it, matched as contiguous name parts (Names): 'orion' matches harbor_orion, OrionConfig. 'repos': exact repo names whose systems are fixed here, overriding the name parts; an empty list means the repo spans systems (a team handbook), so its work has no known system. Scope names of the collective that a known repo name contains are systems too (derived, no entry needed).
